The Emergency Escalation Process includes the maintenance of the on-call list.
context: On-Call List: Maintained by Operations, updated monthly

description: The process involves classifying the type of emergency to determine the correct point of contact.
context: System outage: Call IT On-Call... Security incident: Call Security On-Call... Regulatory issue: Call CRO... Customer crisis: Call CEO/COO

description: If the emergency is classified as a system outage, it routes to IT On-Call.
context: System outage: Call IT On-Call (0800-888-TECH)

description: If the emergency is classified as a security incident, it routes to Security On-Call.
context: Security incident: Call Security On-Call (0800-888-SECU)

description: If the emergency is classified as a regulatory issue, it routes to the CRO.
context: Regulatory issue: Call CRO Mobile (registered with ops team)

description: If the emergency is classified as a customer crisis, it routes to the CEO/COO.
context: Customer crisis: Call CEO/COO (registered with ops team)

description: The Operations Team is responsible for maintaining and updating the on-call list.
context: On-Call List: Maintained by Operations, updated monthly
